description: This is a React functional component named SeedCard that provides a user interface for seeding demo data in a dashboard application. It includes a button that triggers the seed operation and displays status messages.

methods.name: SeedCard()
methods.description: React functional component for a sidebar card to seed demo data, including state for busy indicator and message, and functionality to trigger data seeding.

methods.name: runSeed
methods.description: Asynchronous function called when user clicks the seed button; invokes seedDemoData and updates UI with success or error message.
